speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've recently been treated for acute sinusitis with antibiotics and are now experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever. Have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as increased frequency, urgency, or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis

I suspect the infection has spread from your recent sinusitis to your kidneys. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and urine culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound.
